messages:
Elliot B: Hey all 1 I just joined and saw an orientation slot on my calendar for Thu 09:00 but no join link. My calendar shows the event in BST which confused me because the organizer is in PT. Can someone confirm the actual UTC time and paste the meeting link? Also where will the recording be stored?

Marta (People Ops): Welcome Elliot! :wave: Core orientation is Thu 09:00 PT. That equals 16:00 UTC / 17:00 BST. Link should be in the event on the shared 'Redwood Onboarding' calendar; mailers sometimes hide links. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/6789012345 (passcode: onboard2026). Recordings go to Drive: https://drive.reddemo.company/onboarding/ under a dated folder.

Onboarding Bot: FYI: orientation events default to Pacific Time. Recording + transcript uploaded to Drive within 24 hours.

Elliot B: Thanks. Any chance the Drive upload will include a short timestamped agenda or chapters? I9m in a different timezone and often watch sections later.

Zara L: We try to add a timestamped agenda doc and request chapter markers from the recorder. If chapters aren't possible, the agenda will include minute marks.

Kai (Calendar Ops): Quick tip: if your client shows UTC and the link is missing, open the invite from the shared calendar (not the email). Also we9ll update the event template to include explicit PT + UTC times and a small table for common zones (ET/BST/AEST) so it's clearer for international hires.

Elliot B: That9d be super helpful. One more: I9m seeing two invites (Core and "Regional Q&A"). Should I accept both?

Marta (People Ops): Accept Core. Regional Q&A is optional and recorded separately; the recording will be placed in the same Drive area under a REGIONS-<date> folder. If you want region-specific info (benefits, local payroll), join REGIONS.

Elliot B: Great, thanks everyone. I9ll accept Core and watch the recording if needed.

Onboarding Bot: Reminder scheduled: upload orientation recording to Drive (+24h) and post link to this thread
